svg.text: Controller Z — Silicon Bring-up to Mass Production
Board arrival gates first silicon boot.
Qualification closure precedes the release decision.
Firmware: Architecture, firmware delivery, and silicon bring-up.
System Validation: Hardware readiness, performance, and qualification evidence.
Product Engineering: Production validation and release readiness.
4. Firmware finished late; the EVB gate moved with it.
5. Bring-up finish leaves no reserve before DVT.
